faqs.q: How do I book an appointment?
faqs.a: WhatsApp is the fastest way — message {whatsapp} and we reply during opening hours. You can also call the same number or email {email}. Walk-ins are welcome subject to availability, but booking ahead means we can set aside the right amount of time.
Yes. A 20% deposit secures your booking. The balance is settled at the salon on the day.

faqs.q: How far in advance should I book?
faqs.a: Please book at least 24 hours in advance so we can plan the day around your service.
Cancellation is free within 24 hours of paying your deposit, and you can reschedule at any time — just let us know.

faqs.q: How long will my appointment take?
faqs.a: Between 20 minutes and 4 hours, depending on the service. Longer braiding, knotless and loc work sits at the top of that range, so allow plenty of time.

faqs.q: Do you have prices for nails, makeup, gele, facials, lashes and threading?
faqs.a: These are quoted on enquiry rather than listed, because the work is tailored to you. Message us with what you have in mind and we will confirm the price before you book. The full hair price list is published on this page.

faqs.q: Do you style children’s and teenagers’ hair?
faqs.a: Yes. Cornrows, single plaits and box braids for children and teenagers are all in the price list, under Kids & Teens.
